steps.say: A fraction over a fraction is the top fraction divided by the bottom one. Dividing by \(\frac{[[right_num]]}{[[right_den]]}\) means multiplying by its reciprocal, \(\frac{[[right_den]]}{[[right_num]]}\).
Multiplying the two fractions gives \(\frac{[[out_num]]}{[[out_den]]}\), which is already in lowest terms after reducing.

answer: So the complex fraction simplifies to \(\frac{[[out_num]]}{[[out_den]]}\).
